questions.question: A crate of egg holds one rotten egg out of every 25 egg in it. If 5 out of 8 rotten eggs are unusable and there are total 10 unusable eggs in the crate, then calculate the number of eggs in the crate.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In every 25 eggs 1 egg is rotten

In every 8 rotten eggs 5 are unusable

**Calculation:**

There are 5 unusable eggs out of 8 rotten eggs

⇒ There are 5 × 2 = 10 unusable eggs out of 8 × 2 = 16 rotten eggs.

Now,

1 egg is rotten out of 25 eggs

**∴ 16 eggs are rotten out of 25 × 16 = 400 eggs.**

questions.question: Rs. 18200 is divided among X, Y and Z in the ratio of 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/2. What is the share (in Rs.) of X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of money divided among x : y : z = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/2

**Calculation:**

LCM of (3, 4, 2) = 12

Multiply the ratio by their LCM

Ratio of money divided among x : y : z = (1/3 : 1/4 : 1/2) × 12 = 4 : 3 : 6

⇒ x = 4a, y = 3a, z = 6a

According to the question,

4a + 3a + 6a = 18200

⇒ 13a = 18200

⇒ a = 1400

**∴ Share of x = 4a = 4 × 1400 = 5600**

questions.question: Selling price of a fan is Rs. 4644. If profit percentage is 29%, then what is the cost price (in Rs.) of fan?
questions.solution:

The selling price of a fan is Rs. 4644, it is sold at 29% profit

**Calculation:**

The selling price of a fan = 4644

C.P of fan × (100 + Profit %)/100 = 4644

⇒ C.P of fan × 129/100 = 4644

**∴ C.P. of fan = Rs. 3600**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

we know C.P = S.P × 100/(100 + P)

So, C.P = 4644 × 100/129 = 3600

questions.question: S, T and U together can complete a work in 30 days. If the ratio of efficiency of S, T and U is 20 : 15 : 12 respectively, then in how many days U alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

S, T and U together can complete a work in 30 days. If the ratio of efficiency of S, T and U is 20 : 15 : 12 respectively

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken to complete total work by S, T and U together = 30 days

Ratio of efficiency of S, T and U = 20 : 15 : 12

Total efficiency = 1/(Total time taken)

⇒ 20k + 15k + 12k = 1/30

⇒ k = 1/1410

**∴ Time taken by U to complete the whole work = 1/(U’s efficiency) = 1/12k = 1410/12 = 235/2 days**

questions.question: A train is moving at the speed of 90 km/hr. How many seconds it will take to cover a distance of 2275 meter?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train is moving at the speed of 90 km/hr

**Concept used:**

• Speed = Distance/Time

• km/hr × 5/18 = m/s

**Calculation:**

⇒ 90 × 5/18 = 2275/Time

⇒ 25 = 2275/Time

⇒ Time = 91 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 91 sec**

questions.question: If the measure of the interior angle of a regular polygon is 90° greater than the measure of its exterior angle, then how many sides does it have?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• The interior angle of a regular polygon = exterior angle of polygon + 90°

• Each interior angle of a regular polygon = 180° – (360°)/N

• Each exterior angle of a regular polygon = 360°/N

**Calculation:**

Let no. of sides of the given polygon is N

⇒ 180° – (360°)/N = (360°)/N + 90°

⇒ 180° – 90° = (360°)/N + (360°)/N

⇒ (720°)/N = 90°

**∴ N = (720°)/(90°) = 8**

questions.question: Find the volume (in cm³) of a hemisphere of diameter 21 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diameter of the hemisphere is 21 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3) × πr³

Diameter = 2 × Radius

**Calculation:**

The Diameter = 21 cm

So, the radius = 21/2 cm

The volume of Hemisphere = 2/3 × πr³

⇒ 2/3 × 22/7 × 21/2 × 21/2 × 21/2

⇒ 4851/2 = 2425.5 cm³

**∴ The volume of the Hemisphere is 2425.5 cm³**
